== Biography ==
Adam was born about 1840. He was the son of [[Glasgow-1675|William Glasgow]] and [[Glendinning-340|Nancy Glendinning]]. He passed away in 1907.
* Fact: Burial   Dayton, Montgomery County, Ohio, United States of America
